feeds.title: Cidercraft Magazine
feeds.description: CIDERCRAFT is the first and only print publication dedicated to cider in North America. We are devoted to shining a light on the evolution and resurgence of one of the oldest beverages on the continent, bringing both education and appreciation of the drink to the people. Follow this site and get all articles and information on cider.

feeds.description: About Cider Chat, a podcast and cider hub for cidermakers and enthusiasts! Grab a glass. Join the chat.

feeds.title: Twisted Cider Blog
feeds.description: Twisted Cider is family run business with an honest approach to cider making. Twisted Cider makes cold pressed Craft Cider with a refreshing, memorable taste from delicious cider apples for you to enjoy.

feeds.title: Cider With Maria
feeds.description: Cider with Maria began as a correspondence venture to update some friends in the UK on the growing cider industry in North America, particularly the events at Cider Con.

feeds.title: Cider Says
feeds.description: A hard cider enthusiast blog focusing on cider reviews, based in Seattle Washington. Follow this site and get reviews and articles on cider.

feeds.title: Along Came a Cider
feeds.description: Exploring the world, one cider at a time. I've been enjoying hard ciders for about fifteen years and apples for far longer. This blog came about when I decided that I couldn't keep up with America's hard cider renaissance without writing down my impressions. As I learn more and more about this most perfect of refreshments, I promise to share here. Cheers! Follow this blog to get opinions and reviews on hard cider.

feeds.title: Real Cider
feeds.description: Together with you, we're championing the 'Real' Cider movement! Supporting cider makers, pubs, and cider fans by providing the latest information on how to enjoy traditional 'Real' Cider. Discover the wonderful world of 'Real' cider by learning about and appreciating some of the best cider's and perries for your company, club or party.

feeds.title: The Cider Crate - A Canadian/Ontario Cider Blog
feeds.description: We love cider! Our site has news, reviews, cocktails and more w/ a specific focus on Ontario Craft Cider.

feeds.title: Ash & Elm Cider Company Blog
feeds.description: Ash & Elm Cider Co. makes and serves craft cider out of their production facility and tasting room on the near eastside of downtown Indianapolis.

feeds.title: Cider Culture
feeds.description: Cider Culture is a blog / digital publication for cider lovers that features events, a cidery finder, interviews with cider makers, recipes and articles. Follow this site and get news and information including cider recipes, events, styles, trends, destinations and producers.

feeds.title: Brix Cider Blog
feeds.description: Brix Cider blends tradition and modern science in making artisanal hard cider. We grow over 70 apple varieties on our orchard in Barneveld, Wisconsin, and we source additional apples from local orchards and wild apple trees.

feeds.title: Hard Cider Reviews
feeds.description: HardCiderReviews.com is an independent review site. We've traveled in excess of 40,000 miles and have taste tested more than 450 varieties of commercially produced and small batch craft cider from 150 hard cider brands. Extensive list of hard cider brands includes tasting samples from regional craft cider makers and artisan ciders, as well as domestic and imported commercial cider producers.

feeds.title: Pommel Cyder
feeds.description: Mark Turdo has been drinking and researching (sometimes simultaneously) cider for over twenty years. Starting in October 2012 he began making cider at home. Since 2013 he's written the Pommel Cyder blog, where he shares some of his cider-making experiments and cider history research.

feeds.title: The Ciderologist - The place to get the incider knowledge
feeds.description: Welcome to the world of The Ciderologist. Here you will find ramblings, musings, photos and videos all dedicated to the wonder of the fermented apple. The Ciderologist has a passion for cider and wishes to share it with the world to make it a better place. The future's looking rosy with cider. Wassail!

feeds.description: Deciderly good cider, made in Wales. Learn about Apple County Cider Co

feeds.title: Cider Snob Notes
feeds.description: I call this a cider blog but it may be something else entirely. I'm hoping that if you like cider then you'll like what you see here. Cider news, history, poetry, art, & apples.

feeds.title: Crafty Nectar Blog
feeds.description: Discover the best craft ciders from artisan cider makers. Enjoy a selection of delicious new ciders each month from the UK's top artisan producers. CraftyNectar is cider drinking made easy! Follow this blog and get cider news, latest cider products and cider industry news.

feeds.title: Juicing Systems

feeds.title: Northwest Cider Association

feeds.title: Real Cider Reviews

feeds.title: Jack's Hard Cider
feeds.description: A lot is read into the word craft or micro-produced. But how many cider companies have been growing apples for over 50 years? Not many. With Jack's Hard Cider, we pride ourselves in the fact that we produce a hard cider from the ground up literally.
